ze_Obf_NPST_v2
行动代号:黑山基地v2

Map by Trazix.
v1 Port by Nino
v2 Update by @Seth.

<Different between CSGO v2 version:>
From Trazix request..
·This version is combine v14 + v2's Boss Fight and Npcs.
·Zm tp and spawn are not like CSGO v2 version.(v14 design)
·You need to find the Baguette to trigger the true ending.(table at first elevator.)
·Two boss fight are kinda changed cuz cs2 don't have vscripts.
·Music will random pick v14 or v2 to play every new round.
·Final true ending darksyth music has replace with new remix.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

<注意！与CSGO版v2的区别：>
·应Trazix的要求,CS2的v2不再是GO版的流程,而是v14的基础上添加v2的Boss战和Npc.
·两场Boss战由于重做会有一点区别.
·地图音乐会在开局选出只播放v14或v2的曲目.
·v2真结局战歌已被替换为Trazix混音版.
·真结局触发修改为寻找法棍交给原本触发房的Gman.(出第一个电梯右边桌子)
